title: Quick Dense Turkish Chicken Pilaf
description: A citrusy and dense Turkish dish featuring makrut lime leaves, perfect for a solo dinner, made with a pasta water emulsion and served on a Talavera plate.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the makrut lime leaves, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cauliflower rice to the skillet and cook, stirring frequently, until it starts to soften, about 3 minutes.
Add the pasta water to the skillet and stir to combine, creating a creamy emulsion.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the liquid has been absorbed and the cauliflower rice is tender, about 10 minutes.
Stir in the lemon juice and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Serve the pilaf hot, garnished with additional makrut lime leaves if desired, on a Talavera plate.
